note: Pure data slice: stable English ids, Chinese names, slot/category, fixed-protocol summaries. No embedded scripts.

cores.name: Near-Enemy Sight
cores.protocol: Identify the nearest 1 visible valid enemy every 1 second

cores.name: Mark Prism
cores.protocol: Distinguish marked targets, elites, and bosses; retain 2 candidates

cores.name: State Parser
cores.protocol: Read 2 public states on the current target every 0.25 seconds

cores.name: Danger Forewarning
cores.protocol: Identify 1 visible hazard zone or windup and report it 0.6 seconds early

cores.name: Direct-Approach Legs
cores.protocol: Follow the shortest viable direction toward the current target to maintain skill slot 1's fixed safe band: approach when too far, retreat at point-blank range, and stop inside the band

cores.name: Range-Keeping Legs
cores.protocol: Continuously maintain the player's near, medium, or far range band; bands follow Piercing Arrow's actual range and avoid oscillation at their edges

cores.name: Circling Hunt Legs
cores.protocol: Move around the current single target in a fixed direction

cores.name: Evasive Legs
cores.protocol: Dodge the highest-priority visible danger, with basic escape support

cores.name: Single-Key Executor
cores.protocol: Cast skill slot 1 when target, resources, and cooldown permit

cores.name: Alternating Executor
cores.protocol: Use skill slots 1 and 2 in a fixed A->B sequence

cores.name: Sustain Executor
cores.protocol: Maintain 1 ongoing effect, refreshing within a basic safety margin

cores.name: Cash-Out Executor
cores.protocol: Read 1 public threshold across at most 3 steps, then use the cash-out skill

cores.name: Short-Trace Memory
cores.protocol: Store the current target and last committed action

cores.name: Twin-Timer Memory
cores.protocol: Store 2 timers, each lasting up to 8 seconds

cores.name: Lineage Cache
cores.protocol: Store 1 event lineage, 1 settlement snapshot, and its consumption receipt

attachments.name: Wish Collector
attachments.protocol: Prioritize pickups by the Law Lens wishlist and send items to the reward chest

attachments.name: Law Sieve
attachments.protocol: Distinguish useful now, cheap to reshape, and salvage; retain according to presets

attachments.name: Fork Compass
attachments.protocol: Choose branches using public tags such as Laws, Law Tokens, and proxy components

attachments.name: Renewal Relay
attachments.protocol: After settlement, begin the next contract with preset length, difficulty, and tags

attachments.name: Range Gauge
attachments.protocol: Store a separate near, medium, or far range preference for each of the three active skills

attachments.name: Boss Plan Library
attachments.protocol: Recognize phase signals and public interactions from previously defeated bosses

attachments.name: Refresh Metronome
attachments.protocol: Coordinate refresh windows for marks, cultures, and other ongoing states with the main loop

attachments.name: Cash-Out Guardian
attachments.protocol: Recommend an early cash-out before a chain breaks, overheating occurs, or the target leaves

attachments.name: Evasion Safety Latch
attachments.protocol: Handle Dodge, potions, and interruption recovery; after Immortality, switch to silence resistance and loop protection

attachments.name: Loop Resetter
attachments.protocol: Detect blocked paths, missing targets, no damage, or invalid repeated casts and perform a fixed reset

firmwares.name: Marked Target Priority
firmwares.semantics: Prefer targets carrying the designated public mark within valid range

firmwares.name: Target Continuity
firmwares.semantics: Do not switch targets voluntarily while the current target's key state remains active

firmwares.name: Danger Override
firmwares.semantics: Severe danger detection can override ordinary target selection

firmwares.name: Return After Dodge
firmwares.semantics: After dodging, return to the previous range band or task area

firmwares.name: Unbroken Orbit
firmwares.semantics: When circling, prefer viable paths that do not let the ongoing chain expire

firmwares.name: Casting Anchor
firmwares.semantics: Stop voluntary movement during the designated skill's windup

firmwares.name: Strict Alternation
firmwares.semantics: Do not advance the A->B sequence without a success receipt from the previous step

firmwares.name: Invalid Cast Suppression
firmwares.semantics: Do not submit skill actions when resources, target, or range are invalid

firmwares.name: Safe Refresh
firmwares.semantics: Calculate the latest safe refresh time from remaining duration and the component's own error margin

firmwares.name: Threshold Cash-Out
firmwares.semantics: Cash out at the player's chosen heat, poison-chain, or snapshot threshold

firmwares.name: Timer Inheritance
firmwares.semantics: Switching targets or dodging does not clear timers that remain valid

firmwares.name: Per-Target Ledger
firmwares.semantics: Store states, hit history, and refresh times separately for each target

firmwares.name: Lineage Handoff
firmwares.semantics: Successor actions consume only confirmed settlement snapshots from the designated source

firmwares.name: Wishlist Override
firmwares.semantics: Override ordinary pickup priority when a wishlist target appears

firmwares.name: Risk-Weighted Fork
firmwares.semantics: For equal reward tags, choose the branch with lower predicted interruption risk

firmwares.name: Continuous Contracts
firmwares.semantics: Begin the next contract only after all stop checks pass
